name: AgentResolver
purpose: Open-world non-custodial capability procurement for agents, with paid live verification only when catalog evidence is insufficient
policy: When an agent needs an external capability, call procure with its hard budget/network/protocol/schema constraints. Treat rejected candidates as unusable and eligible_with_unknowns as unresolved evidence. The calling agent retains sole spending authority. Use resolve only for broad unconstrained discovery; use paid verification only when fresh evidence is worth its quoted price.

bodyExample.goal: Find an external capability that can complete this task

paidActions.name: x402 Payment Preflight & PayTo Verification
paidActions.useWhen: Before authorizing payment to an unfamiliar or changed x402 endpoint, verify the live payTo recipient, quote, network, USDC asset, resource binding, challenge structure, TLS and reachability.
paidActions.authorizationBoundary: Preflight returns evidence and an eligible/blocked decision; the caller must independently authorize any target payment. AgentResolver does not sign, custody, or forward target funds.

paidActions.name: MCP Live Preflight
paidActions.useWhen: Free discovery found one concrete MCP endpoint and current reachability, compatibility, latency, or tool inventory matters before depending on it.

paidActions.name: Agent Readiness Audit
paidActions.useWhen: An agent or operator needs to know whether a public site is machine-discoverable and exposes usable agent integration signals.

paidActions.name: Verified Resolve
paidActions.useWhen: The agent needs an evidence-backed choice among capability candidates rather than discovery-only metadata.

bodyExample.goal: Find and verify an MCP server for search

paidActions.name: Batch Verified Resolve
paidActions.useWhen: The agent needs up to four missing capabilities selected and live-checked in one bounded purchase.

items.goal: Find a browser automation MCP server

buyerSetup.when: Use this free handoff when the host can discover or call AgentResolver but stops after a 402 because it has no x402-aware signer/payment retry loop.
buyerSetup.authorizationBoundary: The caller owns the signer and spend policy. Never send a private key or seed phrase to AgentResolver; AgentResolver does not authorize spend.
